    • withPeerExpiration

      public RTCSettings withPeerExpiration(Duration peerExpiration)
      Returns a copy with the timeout for considering a peer inactive changed.

      Returns:
      a copy with the specified peer expiration period
      Throws:

      a copy with the specified interval

    • withP2pAttemptTimeout

      public RTCSettings withP2pAttemptTimeout(Duration p2pAttemptTimeout)
      Returns a copy with the timeout for an individual peer-to-peer connection attempt changed. The give-up timeout is recalculated from this value.
      Parameters:
      p2pAttemptTimeout - maximum duration of one peer-to-peer connection attempt
      Returns:
      a copy with the specified attempt timeout
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if p2pAttemptTimeout is null

    • withQueuedSendTimeout

      public RTCSettings withQueuedSendTimeout(Duration queuedSendTimeout)
      Returns a copy with the maximum time to wait for a queued send changed.
      Parameters:
      queuedSendTimeout - maximum wait for a queued send to be accepted for transmission
      Returns:
      a copy with the specified queued-send timeout

    • withMaxDirectPeers

      public RTCSettings withMaxDirectPeers(int maxDirectPeers)
      Returns a copy with the maximum number of directly connected peers changed.
      Parameters:
      maxDirectPeers - maximum number of direct peers; must be between 2 and 64, inclusive
      Returns:
      a copy with the specified direct-peer limit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxDirectPeers is outside the supported range

    • withStunServers

      public RTCSettings withStunServers(Collection<String> stunServers)
      Returns a copy configured with the supplied STUN server addresses. The collection is copied when the new settings are created.
      Parameters:
      stunServers - STUN server addresses, in host:port form
      Returns:
      a copy configured with these STUN servers
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if stunServers or an entry is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if an entry is blank

    • withSignalingRelays

      public RTCSettings withSignalingRelays(Collection<String> signalingRelays)
      Returns a copy configured with the supplied Nostr signaling relay URLs. The room ensures these URLs on its signaling pool when it is constructed; relay connections proceed asynchronously. An empty collection configures no additional relays, though the room can still use relays already in its pool.
      Parameters:
      signalingRelays - WebSocket relay URLs; entries must not be null or blank
      Returns:
      a copy configured with these signaling relays
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if signalingRelays or an entry is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if an entry is blank

    • withStunServer

      public RTCSettings withStunServer(String stunServer)
      Returns a copy with one STUN server appended to the configured list. Duplicate entries are preserved.
      Parameters:
      stunServer - STUN server address in host:port form
      Returns:
      a copy with the server appended

    • withoutStunServer

      public RTCSettings withoutStunServer(String stunServer)
      Returns a copy with one matching STUN server removed from the configured list. If the address occurs more than once, only its first occurrence is removed.
      Parameters:
      stunServer - STUN server address to remove
      Returns:
      a copy with the first matching server removed, or an unchanged copy if the address is not configured

    • getDefault

      public static RTCSettings getDefault(String applicationId, String protocolId)
      Creates settings with the default RTC options and public signaling relays.
      Parameters:
      applicationId - nonblank application identifier shared by peers in the room
      protocolId - nonblank protocol identifier shared by peers in the room
      Returns:
      a new settings instance for the specified application and protocol
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either identifier is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if either identifier is blank
